summary: If cowsay is installed Ansible uses it in output; disable it by uninstalling cowsay, setting nocows=1 in ansible.cfg, or exporting ANSIBLE_NOCOWS=1.
questions: How do I get rid of the cow in Ansible output?

answer_card.title: Disable cowsay
answer_card.answer_md:
Uninstall cowsay, or:

```ini
[defaults]
nocows = 1
```

or `export ANSIBLE_NOCOWS=1`.
